selectiveLlmValidation.pipeline: Deterministic + Unified Validator (LLM Gated via Content Hash)

architecturalRecommendation.rationale: Deterministic processing achieves 95% accuracy with 0ms latency and $0 cost. LLM validation adds marginal gain (+1 offer) at significant latency and API cost. Invariant #6 (Zero-cost LLM gate) is strictly enforced: LLM is invoked only when content hash changes and confidence is low.
architecturalRecommendation.humanReviewRouting: Ambiguous retail cases lacking branch details (e.g., Softlogic Max, Everton Holidays) are safely routed to admin dashboard review rather than prompting expensive or speculative LLM inference.
